interpretation_ko: 남에게 당해서 귀중한 물건을 빼앗길 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will be victimized and robbed of some valuable object

cite.original: To dream of falling into a rat-trap, denotes that you will be victimized and robbed of some valuable object.
cite.translation_ko: 쥐덫에 빠지는 꿈은, 남에게 당해서 귀중한 물건을 빼앗길 조짐이다

interpretation_en: foretells the absence of slander or competition

cite.original: To see an empty one, foretells the absence of slander or competition.
cite.translation_ko: 쥐덫이 비어 있는 것을 보는 꿈은, 비방이나 경쟁이 없을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be rid of unpleasant associations

cite.original: A broken one, denotes that you will be rid of unpleasant associations.
cite.translation_ko: 부서진 쥐덫을 보는 꿈은, 불쾌한 인연에서 벗어날 조짐이다
